objective: Compare early warning and two-session confirmation against hold on genuinely prospective, timestamped scanner candidates, avoiding reuse of explored historical holdout.

signal_eligibility.source: original scanner decision log only; calendar proxy and screenshot excluded
signal_eligibility.chronology: provider_quote_utc <= decision_utc <= observed_utc; reject missing/naive timestamps
signal_eligibility.delivery: ntfy notified_utc is reservation/send-attempt timestamp, not phone receipt

cohort.exit: existing position exit warnings evaluated separately, never relabeled as entries
cohort.duplicate: one candidate per symbol, family, decision timestamp and rule version
cohort.benchmark: hold from same hypothetical executable entry, same time horizon

policies.description: Two consecutive qualifying sessions: research review signal, not an order

costs: Report observed broker-specific costs when available; otherwise label all cost assumptions and stress test 10/25/50 bps.

validation.registration: Commit before evaluating new candidate outcomes; no retrospective backfilling
validation.analysis_unit: entry date / market regime block, not independent stock rows
validation.comparison: paired within same candidate and common horizon
validation.uncertainty: date-cluster and contiguous block bootstrap; report sample sizes and intervals
validation.selection: No strategy promotion based on explored 2024-2026 holdout; require new untouched prospective data
validation.minimum_evidence: Do not assert edge until adequate independent time blocks, coverage, execution assumptions, and stability documented

guardrails: No merge to main without explicit approval
No private state, tokens, holdings or user identifiers in public repo
Do not claim live signal or trade without independent provenance
